title: Digital receivable created successfully
description: Emitted as the digital_receivable_create_success event type when a digital receivable registered through the create digital receivable API is persisted by the asynchronous create flow, and re-emitted for the existing receivable when the same request is retried with the same correlation ID. One event is emitted per digital receivable. Consumers can use it to confirm registration and to obtain the generated digital receivable unit ID.

digital_receivable_id.title: Digital receivable ID
digital_receivable_id.description: Client-provided identifier of the digital receivable, up to 20 characters, unique per organization.

digital_receivable_unit_id.title: Digital receivable unit ID
digital_receivable_unit_id.description: UUID generated by Pismo for the digital receivable unit the receivable was grouped into on creation.

lender_document_number.title: Lender document number
lender_document_number.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the lender, client-provided on digital receivable creation and never changed afterwards.

debtor_document_number.title: Debtor document number
debtor_document_number.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the debtor, client-provided on digital receivable creation and never changed afterwards.

face_value.title: Face value
face_value.description: Face value of the digital receivable in BRL with up to 5 decimal places, client-provided on creation.

maturity_date.title: Maturity date
maturity_date.description: Maturity date of the digital receivable in yyyy-MM-dd format, client-provided on creation.

situation_type.title: Situation type
situation_type.description: Current situation of the digital receivable, from the DigitalReceivableSituationType enum. ACTIVE: the receivable is live and free to be negotiated. BLOCKED: the receivable is live but encumbered, for example by a guarantee contract or an endorsement pledge. COMPLETED: the receivable was fully settled and has no available balance. INACTIVE: the receivable was cancelled through a settlement of type CANCELLATION. A newly created receivable is always ACTIVE.

reason_type.title: Reason type
reason_type.description: Reason behind the current situation_type, from the ReasonType enum, either client-provided on creation or derived by Pismo from contracts, instrument acts and settlements. LIVR: Livre, free of restrictions and available for negotiation. BLOQ: Comprometida, committed to a contract or negotiable instrument act. BQSD: Bloqueada pelo sacador, blocked by the drawer (lender). BQCJ: Bloqueada por constrição judicial, blocked by a court order. COMT: Completada, the receivable is settled. Absent when no reason type is set.

debtor_has_digital_receivable.title: Debtor has digital receivable
debtor_has_digital_receivable.description: Indicates whether the debtor document number has at least one digital receivable registered in the organization, read from the debtor summary kept by Pismo.

debtor_has_liquidate_digital_receivable.title: Debtor has liquidated digital receivable
debtor_has_liquidate_digital_receivable.description: Indicates whether the debtor document number has at least one settled (liquidated) digital receivable in the organization, read from the debtor summary kept by Pismo.
